provenance.note: Scored over OSM extracts, the First Census of Water Bodies table (Supabase water_bodies_census), and internal artifacts (river-quality.json, industrial-sources.json, chennai-water-bodies-lost.geojson) whose citations travel with their own envelopes - internal inputs are lineage, not sources. Algorithm identity in the payload `weights` key. March 2026 vintage; the GEE flagship scorer (neer-vazhvu-api/app/gee) READS this file for target selection, it does not produce it.
